wedding_photographs: INTENTIONALLY ABSENT. The physical wedding album is a separate annual tradition and is deliberately not used. There is no wedding chapter and none is needed.

voiceover.VO-1: I spent a lot of time looking through these pictures, and I realized something.
voiceover.VO-2: I wasn't really looking at pictures of our wedding. Or pictures of vacations. Or pictures of the kids. I was looking at my life.
voiceover.VO-3: Twenty-four years together. Fifteen years married.
voiceover.VO-4: And somehow, you're still the person I want sitting next to me at the end of every day.
voiceover.VO-6: Life hasn't always gone exactly the way we thought it would.
voiceover.VO-7: We've had crazy years, hard years, really good years, and a whole lot of years where we were just trying to keep up with everything.
voiceover.VO-8: But when I look at all of these pictures, I wouldn't change any of it. Because all of it led us here.
voiceover.VO-9: To this family. To these three amazing girls. To the life we built together.
voiceover.VO-11: I don't know what the next fifteen years are going to look like. But I know I want them. With you.
voiceover.VO-12: Happy anniversary. I love you. And if I had to do it all over again... I'd still choose you.

text_cards.text:
Before the house.
Before the kids.
Before all of this —
there was just us.

HAPPY 15TH ANNIVERSARY, MY LOVE.

15 years down. Forever to go.
